item.description:
Back up and restore your library

Export your MCP servers, skills and model providers to a portable setup file, or enable automatic backups in iCloud. Review the contents before restoring and choose how to handle conflicts. Installing restored items into your tools remains a separate Review → Apply step.

Share tool setup across Git worktrees

Related worktrees now appear together and share your choice of tools. Connect, repair or disconnect project links through Review → Apply. While FullHouse is running, new worktrees inherit missing links automatically; conflicts stay in Review.

Improved

  • Model catalogs update independently — FullHouse can receive new models, endpoints and capabilities from the catalog without an app update. Your installed tool configurations change only after Review → Apply. Adding several models from one provider reuses the API key already held in the queue.
  • Find FullHouse MCPs faster — MCP servers maintained by FullHouse appear first in Featured when adding a server.
